name: project-journal
description: Continuous project process tracking and experience-asset engine. One call bootstraps an independent Markdown record folder plus a session anchor in AGENTS.md; afterwards every session auto-resumes and captures decisions, problems, solutions, daily execution, metrics and revenue until monetization succeeds or fails, then publishes a redacted sellable case-study asset pack.

obsidian.purpose: 可视化驾驶舱与五个视图（HOME.md + _views/）；不安装也能正常记录
